claim.quote: The measurement sets constraints on new physics effects at the TeV scale.

name: E158: weak mixing angle at Q^2 = 0.026 GeV^2 and its running

summary.plain: E158's final result, from all three runs: the left-right asymmetry in electron-electron scattering gives the weak mixing angle at low energy. With Z-pole measurements it shows that this fundamental parameter changes with energy, as predicted, at more than six standard deviations.
summary.technical: A_PV = -131 +- 14 stat +- 10 syst ppb, giving sin^2 theta_W^eff = 0.2397 +- 0.0010 stat +- 0.0008 syst at Q^2 = 0.026 GeV^2; combined with Z-pole values, the running of the weak mixing angle is observed with over 6 sigma significance and TeV-scale new-physics effects are constrained.

title: Precision Measurement of the Weak Mixing Angle in Moller Scattering
why_it_matters: A low-energy measurement of the weak mixing angle in a purely leptonic process, and the benchmark the MOLLER experiment aims to improve on by a factor of five.
